[SWS_Eth_91023] Definition of API function Eth_ReleaseRxBuffer
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_Eth_00172
⌈
Service Name
Eth_ReleaseRxBuffer (draft)
Syntax
void Eth_ReleaseRxBuffer (
uint8 CtrlIdx,
Eth_BufIdxType RxHandleId
)
Service ID [hex]
0x27
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different Rx handle ids and Ctrl indexes
CtrlIdx
Index of the controller within the context of the Driver
Parameters (in)
RxHandleId
Unique receive handle id provided by the Ethernet Driver in a
previous call of EthIf_RxIndication, to identify the ingress queue
element per physical Ethernet controller
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Indication from the upper layer to release the reception buffer (ingress queue element) of the
given physical Ethernet controller.
Tags: atp.Status=draft
Available via
EthIf.h
